claims.interpretation: Published BoltzGen antibody generation can preserve known scaffolds; de novo in the paper is not competition eligibility.
Epitope-specific antibody design exists experimentally; affinity maturation and screening were part of the evidence.
Held-out thermostability prediction was limited; require direct Tm rather than interpreting chemical motif changes as thermal improvement.

retrieval_scope: Search-returned abstracts, not full-text review. BoltzGen PMC paper and RFdiffusion primary abstract checked separately; official BoltzGen scaffold example inspected via GitHub.
